CustomField.description: Whether signers may mark up the attached documents (#412 M2) and with which outcome. Off = no markup (default); Decline only = markups go with a decline, so an approval means approved as-is; Approve or decline = markups go with either, so an approval with markups means approved as noted. Each marked-up copy is saved to the related record as a new file. Needs Attached Documents on.
CustomField.label: Attached Document Markup
